### 2026-10-09 – TL;DR- I did the firmware and fix use some issues with my PCB and schematic.

**3.5h**

TL;DR- I did the firmware and fix use some issues with my PCB and schematic.
I spent this session downloading all of the things needed for the firmware, which took a long time because my internet kinda sucks. After I did the firmware and considering that it was my first time in Arduino I think it went ok. While doing that I realized I needed to fix some stuff in the schematic and PCB. Lastly I made my  bunny sprite!!
